# HHH-21072 exploration

needs-a-human: the reported selected enum literal has a narrow, source-supported failure, but independent executable RED is still required before implementation.

Pinned upstream: 18584773ee25a3aa63c541fd560bbc0b707b6fb2. Batch contains only #43; no duplicates to close.

Blast radius is Hibernate core Criteria literal typing and focused tests. SqmLiteral resolves a null-inherent-type literal's Java descriptor from value.getClass(); for a constant-specific enum class body that is an anonymous subclass. BaseSqmToSqlAstConverter.visitLiteral's nodeType-null fallback asserts that this class is an enum and passes it to createEnumType. EnumJavaType.hasManyValues dereferences getEnumConstants(), which is null for the subclass. Assertions enabled in the test build should reveal the earlier AssertionError; the production NPE must not be claimed as a test result without execution.

This is a two-way door: a narrow declaring-class normalization and regression test can be reverted without API, schema, or persisted-format changes. Expected difficulty is small, subject to proving the actual query path and controls.

The existing EnumConstantBodyLiteralTest (HHH-20776) exercises mapped-path comparisons, not a standalone selected literal. Use an id-only entity so mapped enum metadata cannot mask fallback behavior; compare constant-body and ordinary enum selections through public Criteria APIs. Include the reported isNotNull query as a separate control: current visitIsNullPredicate supplies Object inference, so it must not be assumed to reach the same failing fallback. Leave visitAsWrapperExpression unchanged unless separately reproduced.

Read current CONTRIBUTING and the public Sandcastle Java ownership/maintainer-review standards. No build, tests, source edits, or local commits were performed in this read-only Explore stage. The coordinator should run the prepared regression on unchanged production through the focused JDK 25/H2 Actions verifier, record RED, then authorize the existing implementation stage. Reported release comparisons remain unverified. Preserve attribution to public reporter 신성수 and the Jira link.
